title: Emerging inorganic–organic hybrid photocatalysts for solar-driven overall water splitting: progress and perspectives
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00378D, Review Article
Open Access

De-Shan Zhang, Lei Wang, Xiaodong Zhang, Xu-Bing Li, Hangxun Xu, Chen-Ho Tung, Li-Zhu Wu
This review explores emerging inorganic–organic hybrid photocatalysts that boost light harvesting, charge separation, and redox processes for overall water splitting, offering insights for sustainable H2 production.
